manifest.composition_note: Purposive sample, NOT representative traffic. Roughly two thirds of the prompts contain names and one third do not; that ratio was chosen by the authors, so precision and false-alarm figures depend on it. Prompts are correctly cased by design, which is an assumption about typical input: real prompts are often lowercase and informal (see the WNUT-17 results). Written by the assistant (author) and contributed by the project owner (user); a few famous names are included.
manifest.name: prompts: purposive, well-cased
